To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Gpp(CH2)p can promote translocation, but only in the presence of EF-G, (2) Gpp(CH)2p does not promote translocation by a mechanism different from that of GTP, (3) guanylylimidodiphosphate can also promote translocation, (4) GTP is not hydrolyzed during translocation, and (5) GTP hydrolytic activity is not required for translocation.

(a) both guanylylimidodiphosphate and guanyl-methylene diphos-phonate can replace GTP in the promotion of translocation by EF-G, and (b) these two analogs are hydrolyzed in the course of translocation.
